about: SKIR1 (2026-11-11): draft owner decisions, in docs/decisions.json's item shape, for the coordinator to fold in (SKIR1 may not write decisions.json)

items.title: K14 reads the new lists
items.body: K14 (carried cards 1 copy, 6 in all) took 'own card' from each card's old source map. Under the new lists Ashen Spurn had 2 own cards and Map 1 had 5. Now a card first listed on a map counts as that map's own.
options: a) Keep.
b) Revert, and re-place source maps card by card.

items.title: Skirmish rewards on later lists
items.body: You picked some fight rewards for later maps (Terrier Pup, Cricket Drummer, Driftwood Crab, Golden Eagle Diver ...). Decks keep the rule that a reward appears only in its own fight (or a fight that already fielded it). This also leaves Map 13 with 10 usable cards.
options: a) Keep.
b) A later map's fights may use an earlier reward you listed there.

items.title: Six cards over budget on their new map
items.body: Moray Ambusher, Raccoon Nightcrew (Smugglers' Grotto), Mudpuppy, Peat-cutter Vole (Map 5) and Planarian Splitter (Maps 4-5) are over budget where your lists put them; Termite Forager (Map 14) is borderline (100%). They wait on a pending list for your re-fit.
options: a) You re-fit them.
b) Claude fits them by the formula.

items.title: Stone cards left Maps 0-20
items.body: 'No stone until Map 21+': the Malachite Golem (led 8-7 and 8-A-4) and the Pumice Beetle (19-3, 19-6) left their decks; those fights now lead with their new top card.
options: a) Keep.
b) Bring the golem back as an exception.

items.title: Mix gaps the lists cannot fill
items.body: Map 0 has 2 Lumber-cost and 3 Wait cards; Maps 3, 7 and 11 one plain animal; Map 11 two no-Wait cards; Map 1 no usable status card; Map 18 no plain animal. Each map's decks show what its list holds.
options: a) Leave them.
b) Claude suggests 1-2 cards per gap.

items.title: SKIR1's Lumber admin adds
items.body: Carried cards added for a second Lumber maker (no card's first map moved): Map 1 Hazel Coppice, Map 8 Pack Rat Looter and Bone Diviner, Map 9 Salvager Hermit Crab.
options: a) Keep.
b) Drop them.

items.title: Map 13's list is too soft for its fights
items.body: The Redwood Deep's new list (suggestions) leaves 10 usable cards; every fight reads 87-99% wins against targets of 40-85. Its strongest old fighters (Swift Fox, Tasmanian Devil, Bramblewood Lynx) are off the list.
options: a) Put those three back on Map 13's list; Claude re-fits.
b) Keep the list; Map 13 stays easy.

items.title: A card in more than half a map's fights
items.body: Rule used: no card in more than half a map's fights. Where a fight could not reach its band inside it (Coral Current's fillers, Map 20's boss ...), one more fight was allowed. Thin lists make the line tight.
options: a) Half, plus one where a fight needs it.
b) Strictly half; those fights stay off band.

items.title: Four fights the new lists cannot tune
items.body: Map 7's boss reads 79.5% (target 40): Dung Beetle and Planarian Splitter are off its list. 8-7 reads 30% (target 60), 17-8 20% (40), Map 20's boss 78% (50). Map 2's 2-1 / 2-2 were off band before too.
options: a) Claude proposes 1-2 list cards per map for your yes / no.
b) Leave them.

items.title: No defender on four new lists
items.body: BAL9 (JJ28) wants a Guardian defender on every main map 1-19. The 2026-11-11 lists of Coral Current (Map 10), Wolfsbane Tundra (17), The Glass Dunes (18) and Ashen Spurn (19) hold none.
options: a) Claude adds one carried Guardian card to each, then re-fits those maps.
b) Drop JJ28 for the new lists.
